description.en: A low, broad titanosaur reconstruction with small dermal armour elements and a long neck and tail. Fossils support armour presence, but its full-body arrangement, soft tissues and colour remain reconstructed.
description.zh: 低而宽厚的泰坦巨龙类复原，具有小型皮内骨甲及长颈长尾。化石支持骨甲存在，但全身排列、软组织与颜色仍为复原。

diagnostic_targets: Low broad barrel-shaped trunk and wide pelvis, not tall narrow Brachiosaurus shoulders.
Relatively modest neck with small head, long tapering tail and four stout limbs.
Small embedded rounded/subconical dermal plates as restrained shallow bumps, not large pointed armour or flat Stegosaurus plates.
Tiny7–10mm ossicles have inferred flat polygonal outer faces; simplify as subtle local surface detail, not hundreds of giant rounded nodules.
Whole-body placement of armour explicitly reconstructed; no claimed precise fossil row pattern.

scale.basis: Scott Hartman2022 named dorsal/lateral reconstruction estimated8.8m; not a measured complete fossil. NHM12m is a separate genus estimate not used.

scientific_limits.en: Original living reconstruction. Hartman2022 dorsal/lateral skeletal drawing is a reconstruction, not a photograph of a complete individual; 8.8m is its estimated reconstructed length. Original dermal plates and ossicle clusters support armour presence and local structure, not exact whole-body placement or rows. Body breadth, neck posture, missing bones, soft tissues and colour remain reconstructed. Do not equate all PVL4017 bones with one individual.
scientific_limits.zh: 原创活体复原。Hartman2022背/侧骨架图是复原而非完整个体照片，8.8米为该复原估计长度。真实骨甲与小骨片簇支持骨甲存在及局部结构，不确定全身位置和排列。躯宽、颈姿、缺失骨骼、软组织及颜色均含复原；不把所有PVL4017骨骼视为同一个体。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete low broad titanosaur with small embedded dermal armour elements, long neck, four limbs and tapering tail. Not an isolated osteoderm or fossil fragment.
frozen_scientific_scope.specimen_basis: Actually viewed Cerda/Powell2010 Fig1 PVL4017-113 dermal plate and Fig3 PVL4017-208/-119 ossicle clusters. Hartman2022 named dorsal/lateral whole skeleton restoration supplies broad body proportions, not actual specimen completeness.

reference_credits.title: Cerda and Powell2010, Dermal armor histology of Saltasaurus loricatus
